# Game Music Emu

This directory vendors the `gme/` source from [Game Music Emu 0.6.3](https://github.com/libgme/game-music-emu/tree/0.6.3). The project builds only the NSF emulator files needed for the NES title music. `gme/gme_types.h` enables NSF support only.
